comparison: The previous optimization logic versus the new optimization. Concurrent scope and HIR fixes are included in both arms. Both arms use identical dependencies, parser, HIR, CSS matcher, and benchmark source.
changes: Compute only the requested value facts inside expression evaluation; build all public flags once at the API boundary.
Replace the internal Evaluated wrapper with Values.
Use one implementation of string and number predicates.
Recycle the DOM candidate vector through the bounded per-thread kernel buffer pool.
